scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.verify:release-notices: node --test ./scripts/generate-release-notices.test.mjs && node ./scripts/generate-release-notices.mjs verify api && node ./scripts/generate-release-notices.mjs verify web
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.release:start: pnpm run db:migrate:release && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start
scripts.release:validate: pnpm run db:check:migrations && pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:unit && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/web-irc run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/web-irc run test && PORT=4173 BASE_PATH=/web-irc/ pnpm --filter @workspace/web-irc run build && pnpm run audit:licenses && pnpm run verify:release-notices
